visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Characters & Micro-Actions: A woman in a white baseball cap and peach shirt stands at the head of a conference table, gesturing with her hands while speaking to three seated colleagues. A man in a pink cardigan, a woman in a white blazer, and a younger woman in black listen intently, with the man resting his chin on his hand. Object Specifications: Several red and white KFC-branded buckets and boxes of egg tarts are arranged on the light wood table. A large TV screen displays images of fried chicken. Setting & Contextual Background: A modern, bright office meeting room with a yellow accent wall and soft overhead lighting. Physical Text Presence: Large white and black subtitles appear at the bottom, and graphic text overlays are visible on the TV screen. (2) Characters & Micro-Actions: A montage shows a middle-aged woman with short brown hair in various roles: cooking over a stove, loading a front-loading washing machine, sitting in the passenger seat of a car, and watering a potted plant with a spray bottle. Object Specifications: A silver cooking pot, a white washing machine, a glass water sprayer, and colorful flowers (tulips) are shown. Setting & Contextual Background: Transitions between a sunny outdoor field at sunset, a coastal bay with blue water, a home kitchen, and an indoor living area. Physical Text Presence: Stylized colorful text boxes with Chinese characters appear frequently in the center and top of the frame. (3) Characters & Micro-Actions: Extreme close-ups show pieces of fried chicken being picked up. The younger woman in black and the man in pink are seen biting into the crispy chicken with enthusiastic expressions. The middle-aged woman holds a large KFC bucket toward the camera, smiling. Object Specifications: Fried chicken pieces coated in a glistening honey-garlic sauce, golden-brown egg tarts in a box, and various branded buckets. Setting & Contextual Background: An indoor home or studio setting with warm lighting and decorative pink balloons in the background. Physical Text Presence: Vibrant text overlays in pink, yellow, and blue emphasize features of the food. (4) Characters & Micro-Actions: The three main characters (man, middle-aged woman, younger woman) pose together, leaning on a table filled with food. They are seen eating together, with the mother figure biting into a drumstick. Object Specifications: A special 'I Love Mommy' themed KFC bucket set, carnation flowers, and promotional signage. Setting & Contextual Background: A bright studio space decorated with 'Happy Mother's Day' banners and flowers. Physical Text Presence: Detailed promotional text overlays with dates and quantities appear on screen.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 這次母親節檔期合作的是KFC. [Logo]: KFC. (2) [Subtitle]: 活動主題是以媽之名大聲說愛. (3) [Subtitle]: 想要傳達讓媽媽做回自己. (4) [Variety]: 哈? 什麼意思? (5) [Subtitle]: 沒事 我有聽懂. (6) [Variety]: 當我們說. [Subtitle]: 腦海裡第一個浮現的... (7) [Variety]: 煮飯. [Variety]: 洗衣. [Variety]: 接送. [Variety]: 照顧人. (8) [Variety]: 某某的太太. [Variety]: 某某的媽媽. (9) [Variety]: 不再是「某一個人的媽媽」. [Variety]: 或是「誰的誰」. (10) [Subtitle]: 吃了會幸福感爆棚的. [Slogan]: 蜂蜜風味蒜醬脆雞. (11) [Subtitle]: 肯德基的經典咔啦脆雞. (12) [Subtitle]: 淋上特製韓式蜂蜜香蒜醬. (13) [Variety]: 甜甜鹹鹹. [Variety]: 蒜香濃郁. (14) [Subtitle]: 母親節還有超級限定款親子桶組合. (15) [Slogan]: 我愛媽咪親子桶. (16) [Slogan]: 限量7,000組 售完為止.
